portable_spec.description: A restrained per-word title reveal through a real variable-font wght axis. Words rise a short distance, tighten, and move from the Pack minimum to its art-directed rest without synthetic bold or glyph stretching.
portable_spec.inspiration: Editorial title systems where typographic mass arrives as the primary event and geometry only supports it.
portable_spec.usage_notes: Title and kicker slots only. Use it when the Pack supplies a real variable-weight treatment; it is not a body-text animation and never synthesizes a missing axis.
